module: Node "AI Follow Path from Data" (color ai). Makes a vehicle follow a ScriptAI path provided by the "AI Path from File" or "Stored AI Path" nodes (ai.startFollowing). Inputs: flow, reset, path (type aiPath), vehId, loopCount. Output: flow, active when the path is finished. Inspector options: Timescale (min 0.25), reset mode (neverReset, alwaysReset, startReset), "Reset AI" button. Data: handBrakeWhenFinished, straightenWheelsWhenFinished.
notes: loopMode is not saved: it goes back to "neverReset" when the project is reloaded.
If loopCount is not given, the value 0 is sent to ai.startFollowing.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Initializes started, complete, loopMode="neverReset", timeScale=1 and the data.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the Timescale field (minimum 0.25), the reset mode choice and the "Reset AI" button.

getVeh.desc: Returns the vehicle whose id is given as input, or the player's vehicle (getPlayerVehicle(0)) without input.

endAI.desc: Sends ai:scriptStop(handBrake, straightenWheels) to the vehicle.

onVehicleSubmitInfo.desc: Hook called by the command sent every frame (the vehicle's ai.scriptState); when the info is nil for this vehicle and this node, marks the path as finished and stops the AI.

info.desc: AI script state, nil when it is finished.

_executionStopped.desc: Stops the AI if the path was running then resets started/complete to false.

loadPath.desc: Loads the path from the path pin into self.path.

setupAI.desc: Prepares the path (times divided by timeScale, dir/up kept) and sends ai.startFollowing(path, nil, loopCount, loop mode).

work.desc: Handles reset; on the first pass runs setupAI; every frame requests via be:queueAllObjectLua the ai.scriptState() state of each vehicle, which calls the onVehicleSubmitInfo hook back; activates flow once complete.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the Complete and Started states.
